title: signal-taste-bootstrap-gap-20260326
description: The Taste system (taste.spoke.yaml, taste.user.yaml) is not being bootstrapped on new spokes. Spokes log 'No taste files found — skipped' every session for months without escalating or self-initializing. The Historian's nudge output loop is silently disabled on any spoke that hasn't manually created the files.
acceptance_criteria: New spokes auto-initialize taste.spoke.yaml and taste.user.yaml with minimal defaults on first wakeup
Existing spokes without taste files get bootstrapped on next wakeup (not silently skipped)
Historian nudge output loop works on bootstrapped spokes
No taste files found message replaced with auto-initialization action
